items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Hershel Evans was in the band... I remember when Hershel came to town... I think that Hershel was in the band

ctx.x: But I think that that was one of the good things that happened to me, as far as music was concerned, because they were good musicians, and Buck was a real good arranger, you know; a lot of people didn't know that Buck arranged, but Buck Clayton was a good arranger.
I don't know why. You know who was in the band? I just thought of this. Hershel Evans was in the band.
